quote: Build me a small app that keeps track of everything in my home, with a paid pro version that uses Stripe.

cap: Talk asks before it spends anything.

say: An Opus planner splits the app into parts, and Haiku agents take them, each on its own copy. The first agent's machine never started; it was restarted after fifteen minutes.

quote: Add a dark mode to the app.

cap: Talk asks before it sends a request to the agents.

say: The dark mode lands on top of the rest while the other agents work; collisions are redone on the newest code. All ten parts landed, for about two dollars of model time.
